# NIST catalogue fixtures

`api.github.com`, `github.com`, `objects.githubusercontent.com`, `doi.org` and `nvlpubs.nist.gov` together stand in for the NIST-Tech-Pubs release flow (2026-09-14): the latest release, its `allrecords-MODS.xml` asset behind GitHub's redirect, and the DOI → nvlpubs redirect for each record. The MODS document is hand-written in the release's shape: three records, one without a DOI.
